def buildOEEValues(assetPath, oee, a, p, q):		
			oeeColors = system.kanoa.event.getOEEColors({'assetPath':assetPath}, oee, a, p, q)
			badColor = '#cc312e'
			getFontColor = lambda bg: badColor if bg == badColor else ''
			
			return {
				'oee': {'value': oee, 'color': oeeColors['oee'], 'fontColor': getFontColor(oeeColors['oee'])},
				'availability': {'value': a, 'color': oeeColors['availability'], 'fontColor': getFontColor(oeeColors['availability'])},
				'performance': {'value': p, 'color': oeeColors['performance'], 'fontColor': getFontColor(oeeColors['performance'])},
				'quality': {'value': q, 'color': oeeColors['quality'], 'fontColor': getFontColor(oeeColors['quality'])}
			}	

	instances = []

	if value['showTable']: return instances

	for row in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(value['data']):
		row["actualMins"] = (row["durationSecs"] or 0.0) / 60.0
		row["runMins"] = (row["runtimeSecs"] or 0.0) / 60.0
		row["dtMins"] = (row["unplannedDowntimeSecs"] or 0.0) / 60.0
		row["pdtMins"] = (row["plannedDowntimeSecs"] or 0.0) / 60.0
		row["startDate"] = row["runStart"] if row.has_key('runStart') else row['startDate']
		row["endDate"] = row["runEnd"] if row.has_key('runEnd') else row['endDate']
		row["infeedRate"] = ''	if row["modeName"] != 'Production' else '%s %s per min'%(round((row["infeedRateSecs"] or 0.0) * 60.0,1), row["infeedUnits"] or '')
		row["targetRate"] = ''	if row["modeName"] != 'Production' else '%s %s per min'%(round((row["targetCount"] or 0.0) / row["actualMins"],1) if row["actualMins"] > 0 else 0, row["infeedUnits"] or '')

		if row['processTypeName'] == 'batch':
			row["standardRate"] = '{:,.0f} min'.format(row["standardRate"]) if row["standardRate"] else ''
			row['performance'] = min((row['performance'] or 0.0), 1)			
		else:
			div = 1.0 if row['period'] == 'Minute' else 60.0
			row["standardRate"] = '{:,.0f} {} per min'.format(round(row["standardRate"] / div,1), row["infeedUnits"] or '') if row["standardRate"] else ''
			
		oee = (row['availability'] or 0.0) * (row['performance'] or 0.0) * (row['quality'] or 0.0)
		
		row['status'] = None if row["modeName"] != 'Production' else buildOEEValues(row['assetPath'], oee, row['availability'], row['performance'], row['quality'])
		instances.append({'value': row})

	return instances

def buildCountDisplay(countType, countValue, rawCountValue, units):
		if not countValue: return {"value": None, "style":''}
		value = '{:,} {}'.format(round(countValue or 0,1), (units or ''))
		style = {}
		if not rawCountValue: 
			style['fontStyle'] = 'italic'
			style['fontWeight'] = 'bold'
		if countValue < 0: style['color'] = '--kcOrange-60'
		elif countType == 'waste': style['color'] = '--kcRed-60'
		
		return {"value": value, "style":style}			
	
	def buildOEEValues(assetPath, oee, a, p, q):

			getFontColor = lambda bg: badColor if bg == badColor else ''
			
			return {

				'availability': {'value': a, 'color': oeeColors['availability'], 'fontColor': getFontColor(oeeColors['availability'])},

				'quality': {'value': q, 'color': oeeColors['quality'], 'fontColor': getFontColor(oeeColors['quality'])}
			}	
	
	self.view.custom.table.gettingData = True
	data = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(value)
	for row in data:
		row["itemName"] = {"value": row["itemName"], "style":{'backgroundColor': row["itemColor"], 'color': system.kanoa.utilities.getContrastingColor(row["itemColor"]), 'borderRadius': '5px', 'padding': '4px'} if row["itemColor"] is not None else {}}
		row["infeedCount"] = buildCountDisplay("infeed", row["infeedCount"], row["rawInfeedCount"], row["infeedUnits"])
		row["outfeedCount"] = buildCountDisplay("outfeed", row["outfeedCount"], row["rawOutfeedCount"], row["outfeedUnits"])
		row["wasteCount"] = buildCountDisplay("waste", row["wasteCount"], row["rawWasteCount"], row["wasteUnits"])
		row["actualMins"] = (row["durationSecs"] or 0.0) / 60.0
		row["runMins"] = (row["runtimeSecs"] or 0.0) / 60.0
		row["dtMins"] = (row["unplannedDowntimeSecs"] or 0.0) / 60.0
		row["pdtMins"] = (row["plannedDowntimeSecs"] or 0.0) / 60.0
		row["startDate"] = row["runStart"] if row.has_key('runStart') else row['startDate']
		row["endDate"] = row["runEnd"] if row.has_key('runEnd') else row['endDate']
		row["infeedRate"] = ''	if row["modeName"] != 'Production' else '%s %s per min'%(round((row["infeedRateSecs"] or 0.0) * 60.0,1), row["infeedUnits"] or '')
		row["targetRate"] = ''	if row["modeName"] != 'Production' else '%s %s per min'%(round((row["targetCount"] or 0.0) / row["actualMins"],1) if row["actualMins"] > 0 else 0, row["infeedUnits"] or '')
		row['startDateMillis'] = system.date.toMillis(row['startDate'])
		row['endDateMillis'] = system.date.toMillis(row['endDate'])if row['endDate'] else None

		if row['processTypeName'] == 'batch':
			row["standardRate"] = '{:,.0f} min'.format(row["standardRate"]) if row["standardRate"] else ''
			row['performance'] = min((row['performance'] or 0.0), 1)			
		else:
			div = 1.0 if row['period'] == 'Minute' else 60.0
			row["standardRate"] = '{:,.0f} {} per min'.format(round(row["standardRate"] / div,1), row["infeedUnits"] or '') if row["standardRate"] else ''
		
		oee = (row['availability'] or 0.0) * (row['performance'] or 0.0) * (row['quality'] or 0.0)
		
		row['status'] = None if row["modeName"] != 'Production' else buildOEEValues(row['assetPath'], oee, row['availability'], row['performance'], row['quality'])
		row["modeName"] = {"value": row["modeName"], "style":{'backgroundColor': row["modeColor"], 'borderRadius': '5px', 'padding': '4px', 'color': system.kanoa.utilities.getContrastingColor(row["modeColor"])} if row["modeColor"] is not None else {}}

	system.perspective.sendMessage("closeToast", {})

def buildTimeCol(timeValue, timeUnits):
		if (timeValue or 0) == 0: return ''
		return '{:,} {}'.format(round(timeValue,1), timeUnits)

	def buildCount(countValue, countUnits, isRate):
		if (countValue or 0) == 0: return ''
		countUnits = list(set(countUnits))
		countUnit = 'Mixed Units' if len(countUnits) > 1 else countUnits[0]
		return '{:,} {} {}'.format(round(countValue,1), countUnit, 'per min' if isRate else '')

	def buildFootCol(title, span, justify, fontWeight):
		return {"title": title, "span": span, "justify": justify, "align": "center", "style": {"classes": "", 'padding':'0px', 'backgroundColor': bgColor, 'color': foreColor, 'fontWeight': fontWeight}}
	
	if len(value['filterData']) > 0:
		data = value['filterData']
	else:
		data = (value['data'])

	if len(data) == 0: return []
	
	infeedCount = 0.0
	outfeedCount = 0.0
	wasteCount = 0.0
	infeedUnits = []
	outfeedUnits = []
	wasteUnits = []
	actualMins = 0.0
	rtMins = 0.0
	dtMins = 0.0
	pdtMins = 0.0
	
	bgColor = '--kcGray-10'
	foreColor = system.kanoa.utilities.getContrastingColor(bgColor)
	
	for row in data:
		if row['modeName']['value'] != 'Production': continue
		
		if row['rawInfeedCount']: 
			infeedCount += row['rawInfeedCount'] or 0.0
			if row['infeedUnits']: infeedUnits.append(row['infeedUnits'])
		
		if row['rawOutfeedCount']: 
			outfeedCount += row['rawOutfeedCount'] or 0.0
			if row['outfeedUnits']: outfeedUnits.append(row['outfeedUnits'])

		if row['rawWasteCount']: 
			wasteCount += row['rawWasteCount'] or 0.0
			if row['wasteUnits']: wasteUnits.append(row['wasteUnits'])
			
		actualMins += row['actualMins'] or 0.0
		rtMins += row['runMins'] or 0.0
		dtMins = row['dtMins'] or 0.0
		pdtMins = row['pdtMins'] or 0.0
	
	infeedRate = infeedCount / rtMins if rtMins > 0 else 0

	footers = []
	footers.append(buildFootCol('Total', 4, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol(buildCount(infeedCount, infeedUnits, False), 1, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol(buildCount(outfeedCount, outfeedUnits, False), 1, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol(buildCount(wasteCount, wasteUnits, False), 1, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol('', 2, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol(buildTimeCol(actualMins, ''), 1, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol(buildTimeCol(rtMins, ''), 1, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol(buildTimeCol(dtMins, ''), 1, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol(buildTimeCol(pdtMins, ''), 1, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol(buildCount(infeedRate, infeedUnits, True), 1, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol('', 2, 'right', 'bold'))
	
	return [footers]

#	return len(value or []) > self.props.pager.initialOption
	return True

customMethods.script:
row = self.view.custom.table.selection.row
	data = self.view.custom.table.data

	startDate = data[row]['startDate'] if self.view.custom.filter.byShift else data[row]['runStart']
	endDate = data[row]['endDate'] if self.view.custom.filter.byShift else data[row]['runEnd']
	
	params = {'value':{'assetId': data.getValueAt(row, 'assetId'), 'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate}}
	system.perspective.print("%s"%params)
	system.perspective.openPopup('detailViewer', 'kanoa/mes/asset/runReview/runViewer', params, title='Production Details', draggable=True, resizable=True, showCloseIcon=True)
	
	return
